description: Draft v2 dataset: a card per model (#158) with every available format and its hash, computed structure, origin, licence, the fuzzybits reader that loads it, tags and the reference the harness judges it against. Private entries hold an opaque id, the sorted sha256 of their files and the modes they may run in, and nothing else (#184).
versioning: A dataset version never changes once used. This v2 file is a draft until it is frozen: `python -m benchmarks.datasets.freeze` refuses to set `frozen: true` without --freeze, and a frozen v2 is regenerated only as v3. The harness, PR gate (#122) and published history (#123) pin a dataset id.
